name: GABBERKIX
author: Presethead
tagline: A hardcore kick designer for the FM-1
description: GABBERKIX turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a hardcore kick designer: a synthesized 909 shaped by layered filters, distortion and clippers, played on every beat or pitched from the keys and MIDI.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
